title: An iterative Bayesian variational quantum eigensolver with the von Mises-Fisher distribution
summary: We develop an iterative Bayesian variational quantum eigensolver in which the unknown ground state, parametrised as a real unit vector, is inferred through a von Mises--Fisher distribution sequentially updated from Hadamard-test measurements on a single ancilla qubit. Building on a companion paper that treated a single success outcome via exact moment matching, we generalise the scheme to condition on $m$ success outcomes for the likelihood function per iteration.
